title: Zoetis Vetscan Imagyst Allegedly Misclassified Dog's Cancerous Tumor, Leading to Second Surgery and Death

behaviors.text: The system allegedly classified the mass as inflammatory, while a later biopsy found aggressive cancer.
In October 2025, Columbia Veterinary Hospital in The Dalles, Oregon reportedly used Zoetis's Vetscan Imagyst AI to analyze a rapidly growing neck mass in an 11-year-old Belgian Tervuren.
The hospital alleges the first surgery failed to remove all cancer, requiring a second operation; the dog died from complications.
